changelog: - **Three corrections where a Gate is fed from more than one place.** When a Gate takes from another Gate or Converter and from its own Pools, or two Gates merge into one, the engine plans the whole group at once, filling each supply in a fixed order. (1) A Gate that could take 6 from a Pool but was held to 2 further down was still counted as taking 6, so the next Gate on that Pool was planned 4 short of what was there; it now gets what is really left. The other side of this: an earlier supply is now filled first, as the order says, where it was sometimes given nothing, and in such a model a later supply gets less and less can move in total. (2) Where two such Gates feed one Converter, the second has to bring exactly what the Converter’s rate asks of it; unless one of its supplies happened to fit, the whole group moved nothing (5 to be made up of 3 and 2), and when it did fit it could take a billionth too much. It now brings exactly that amount. (3) A Gate set to “pull all” that could not have its full amount, below a Gate fed from two places, was left out while the rest of the group ran, so a Converter was fed on one input only. The whole group now waits, as “pull all” means everywhere else. None of the bundled examples changes. A Monte Carlo result saved before this change is shown as stale until it is run again (engine revision 11).
